description: A source file for a TinyMCE plugin, providing a user interface for configuring table row properties within a WYSIWYG editor environment.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialization function called on page load to set up the plugin UI.

methods.name: updateAction
methods.description: Handles the action to insert or modify table rows based on user input.

methods.name: changedSize
methods.description: Handles changes to the height input, updating the relevant styles.

methods.name: changedStyle
methods.description: Handles updates to style fields like background image and style.

methods.name: changedBackgroundImage
methods.description: Updates the background image based on user input.

methods.name: updateColor
methods.description: Updates color fields based on color picker interaction.
